title: Recipe
description: A single stored recipe. Ingredient entries use the same keys and units as the shopping list in cateringPlanConfig.json, so a recipe can be scaled to the participant count and merged into a catering plan without conversion.

description.description: One or two sentences about the dish.

servings.description: Number of people the listed ingredient quantities are meant for. null while the source text does not state it — the app asks for it instead of guessing a number.

course.description: Where the dish belongs in the menu.

diet.description: Diets the recipe satisfies as written.

quantity.description: Quantity for the stated servings, not for the event.

category.description: Optional shopping category, for example vegetables or dairy.

note.description: Optional preparation hint, for example finely chopped.

steps.description: Preparation steps in order, one sentence each.

source.description: Where the recipe came from, for example a URL or a cookbook.
